reviews.body:
LGTM. 

Please kindly use the PR template when creating PRs to our repositories in the future.

review_comments.body: suggestion: update to use `ariaLabel` property similar to how `vaadin-drawer-toggle` uses it, with `Edit` as default value.
suggestion: add `crud-edit.test.ts` to `crud/test/dom` instead and use snapshot tests rather than unit tests.

comments.body:
Thanks, both suggestions applied (a403fad, 168f161): `ariaLabel` is now a reflected property on `vaadin-crud-edit` with `Edit` as the default (same as `vaadin-drawer-toggle`), replacing the `ready()` check, and the unit tests moved to `packages/crud/test/dom/crud-edit.test.ts` as snapshot tests.

This comment was drafted with Claude Code.
